title: Response A is better than response B
question: Given the user's turns, is response A the better answer than response B at the judged turn (input.judged_turn; earlier turns are context)?
passDescription: Response A is better than response B overall.
failDescription: Response B is better than response A overall.
notes: Adapted from lmsys/mt_bench_human_judgments (expert pairwise votes, multiple judges per pair). humanLabel is the majority vote; reviewerDisagreement is true when judges were not unanimous (including any tie vote). Comparison sample: seed 103 simple random sample of 150 of 1632 judged pairs with a strict majority and under 9,000 characters (of 2396). Responses swapped: response_a is the original response_b.
